images.author: phauck
images.why: Peinado’s distinctive cone with turquoise water and pale volcanic foreground; strong colour contrast. Master image linked; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Whole recognisable cone above black lava fields beneath a clear blue sky. Original-size image endpoint; pixel dimensions unverified.

images.author: Eduardo Cinicola
images.why: Classic Peinado-and-turquoise-lagoon composition, explicitly identified and credited in an expedition account. Lower-resolution fallback; 2000 px not verified.

images.author: Ben Edwards
images.why: Authoritatively identified photograph showing the symmetrical cone and surrounding lava apron. Useful identification-focused alternative; resolution unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Vivid yellow and orange sulphur deposits with steaming fumaroles on the Chile-side excursion. Strong detail-card option; linked rendition is limited to 1920 px wide.

images.author: Adolfo Dell’Orto
images.why: Explicitly captioned northern view of Lastarria during an ascent attempt, with fumarolic activity. Better for showing the volcano’s overall form; resolution unverified.

images.author: Paula Cornejo; courtesy of Oscar González-Ferrán
images.why: Scientifically identified view of Lastarria’s elongated summit and northern flanks, avoiding confusion with Llullaillaco. Resolution unverified.

images.author: José Naranjo
images.why: Confirmed western, Chile-side view of the Olca–Paruma complex; the caption distinguishes Olca, Volcán Paruma and Cerro Paruma. Broad ridge needs a careful 9:10 crop; resolution unverified.

images.author: Luis Salazar Vargas
images.why: Source explicitly identifies Purico-complex summits: Cerro Toco on the left and Cerro Chajnantor on the right, viewed from San Pedro. Resolution unverified.

images.author: Luis Salazar Vargas
images.why: Specifically captioned Cerro Toco seen eastward from Solor; a useful mountain-focused alternative to summit photos showing neighbouring volcanoes. Resolution unverified.

images.author: Jean-Claude Piessevaux
images.why: Explicitly identified west face of Cerro Toco, photographed in July 2008. Shows the requested mountain itself; resolution unverified.

images.author: ESO/E. Emsellem
images.why: Real photographic panorama with a 21452 × 2685 px source. Crop around Toco immediately left of central Chajnantor, excluding Licancabur farther left; substantial cropping required.

images.author: Mohammad Alizade
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies Damavand at sunrise; warm golden light and an isolated cone make a strong poster composition. 3000 px-wide delivery requested.

images.author: Ehsan Eslami
images.why: Classic snow-covered Damavand against a clear blue sky, with a clean silhouette and strong white–blue contrast. 3000 px-wide delivery requested.

images.author: arshia jafari
images.why: Snowy cone, dark volcanic ridges and green foothills beneath blue sky; attractive natural colour separation. 3000 px-wide delivery requested.

images.author: Behtaj Rasouli
images.why: Recognisable snow-streaked cone above layered Alborz foothills, adding depth to a near-square crop. 3000 px-wide delivery requested.

images.author: Hosein Naraghi
images.why: Source locates the photograph at Damavand Peak; snowy mountain against blue sky offers a simple, recognisable card subject. 3000 px-wide delivery requested.

images.author: Mahdi
images.why: Damavand with a lenticular cloud at sunset provides a dramatic colour alternative; the cloud partially obscures the summit. 3000 px-wide delivery requested.
